Product Details: WAAREE 60 kW Three Phase Solar On Grid Inverter High-Performance Solution for Large-Scale Solar Systems - Distributed/Packaged by Waaree. Product Details: Power Output: The inverter's power output is 60 kW, indicating the maximum amount of power it can convert from DC to AC, suitable for large-scale solar installations. Maximum Efficiency: Up to 98% efficiency means that the inverter can convert a high percentage of the DC power from the solar panels into usable AC power, reducing energy losses and maximizing system performance. MPPT Voltage Range: The Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) voltage range specifies the range of voltages at which the inverter can operate efficiently to maximize power output from the solar panels, ensuring optimal performance under varying conditions. Number of MPPT Trackers: Having 2 MPPT trackers means that the inverter can independently track the maximum power point for two separate strings of solar panels, optimizing energy harvest even if the panels have different characteristics or shading conditions. Operating Temperature Range: The inverter can operate in temperatures ranging from -25°C to 60°C, indicating its ability to function in a wide range of environmental conditions, ensuring reliable performance even in extreme temperatures. Communication: The inverter supports communication through RS485, Wi-Fi, and GPRS, enabling remote monitoring and control of the system, allowing users to track performance and troubleshoot issues from anywhere. Protection: The inverter features protection mechanisms such as overvoltage, overcurrent, and overtemperature protection, safeguarding the system against damage, ensuring safe and reliable operation. Grid Connection: The inverter is designed for three-phase AC grid connection, which is common in large-scale solar installations, ensuring compatibility with existing grid infrastructure. Certification: The inverter is certified to meet relevant standards such as IEC and CE, ensuring its quality, reliability, and compliance with safety regulations. Warranty: The inverter comes with a 5-year warranty, providing assurance of its quality and reliability, ensuring peace of mind for users.
